_doc: Measured once, reused until something changes. The passport shows when each was last checked.

items.label: Construction
items.value: Face: hemp warp with weft strips cut from reclaimed post-consumer sari fabric. Backing: handwoven hemp cloth, no artificial dyes. Bound edge with knotted fringe at both ends.

items.label: Looms
items.value: Two hundred-year-old looms (one for the mat face, one for the hemp backing), neither using electricity.
